criteria.description: One hero landmark, one product heading, one lede, exactly two CTAs, one media/play trigger, one video dialog with one iframe and one loading spinner owner, zero nav/dropdown chrome
Media trigger opens ren-dialog lightbox; Escape and close control dismiss; focus returns to trigger; iframe loads with busy indicator then visible embed
Exactly one play/media opener and one dialog close control; CTAs are not duplicated inside the dialog
Text stacks above media when narrow; two-column side-by-side at desktop; no horizontal overflow at 320/390/767/768/1280
JavaScript-disabled view keeps heading, lede, both CTAs, and a usable media destination link without a dead play control
Named play control, dialog title, visible focus, fully visible 44px targets, reduced motion, light/dark tokens, axe WCAG 2.1 AA
Codex reviewed fresh desktop, tablet, mobile, open lightbox, dark, and JavaScript-disabled captures
